landmarks.name: round white ottoman
landmarks.description: Large circular white tufted ottoman in the center of the floor near the open closet and vanity desk.

landmarks.name: vanity desk with mirror
landmarks.description: Small white counter with a grey chair, rectangular mirror, and side wall sconces.

landmarks.name: open closet with white robe
landmarks.description: Dark wood open wardrobe recess with a white bathrobe hanging on the left.

landmarks.name: wooden dresser with two blue paintings
landmarks.description: Four-drawer light wood dresser with two framed blue and yellow abstract paintings on the wall above it.

landmarks.name: large bed with wood-paneled headboard
landmarks.description: King-sized bed with white linens set against a full-height vertical wood-paneled wall with mirrored trim.

landmarks.name: fire extinguisher cabinet
landmarks.description: Recessed white metal wall cabinet with glass window containing a red fire extinguisher.

landmarks.name: wall-mounted TV on wood panel
landmarks.description: Flat-screen TV mounted on a raised wooden wall panel above a long white-topped desk counter.

landmarks.name: open wooden door
landmarks.description: Full-height medium-brown wood grain door propped open against a partition wall between the bed area and the dining table area.

landmarks.name: freestanding white tub
landmarks.description: Oval white bathtub on a dark floor against a white marble-tiled wall.

landmarks.name: large city night painting
landmarks.description: Large horizontal painting with yellow top and dark blue/black abstract city lights on a textured beige wall.

landmarks.name: dark wood dining table with beige chairs
landmarks.description: Long dark live-edge wooden table surrounded by eight beige upholstered cantilever chairs.

landmarks.name: yellow upholstered bench
landmarks.description: Two-piece mustard yellow cube bench at the foot of the large bed.

landmarks.name: tan swivel desk chair
landmarks.description: Tan leatherette upholstered rolling chair at the white desk counter below the wall-mounted TV.

landmarks.name: brown chaise lounge
landmarks.description: Brown fabric sectional chaise sofa positioned near the sheer window curtains beside the large bed.

landmarks.name: wooden console table with three fish sculptures
landmarks.description: Long medium-tone wood console table with three small dark fish statues on top and a black bin underneath, placed behind a beige sofa.

landmarks.name: four-panel blue abstract wall art
landmarks.description: Grid of four rectangular framed blue and grey abstract pictures on the wall near the dining table.

landmarks.name: sheer white window curtains
landmarks.description: Full-height sheer white patterned curtains along the window wall behind the sofa and dining area.

landmarks.name: white Counter with mini-fridge
landmarks.description: Recessed alcove with white lower cabinets, a black-and-stainless under-counter mini-fridge, and a white-framed picture above.

landmarks.name: TV on dark wood media console
landmarks.description: Large flat-screen TV sitting on a dark brown wooden cabinet against the wall near the beige sofa.

landmarks.name: yellow tufted ottoman
landmarks.description: Pair of round mustard-yellow upholstered pouf ottomans on the rug in front of the beige sofa.

landmarks.name: entry wooden door with closer
landmarks.description: Flat medium-wood door with a metal door closer at the top, located at the end of the white-tiled floor area.

landmarks.name: console table with round shell mirror
landmarks.description: Small table with a geometric black metal base, table lamp, and a round mirror framed with dark shells above it on the white-tiled floor.

landmarks.name: white toilet by grey stone-tiled wall
landmarks.description: White ceramic toilet beside a dark grey stacked-stone textured accent wall, with a blue framed picture above.

landmarks.name: floating white sink vanity with backlit mirror
landmarks.description: Wall-mounted rectangular white sink counter with a large backlit mirror on the dark grey textured tile wall.

landmarks.name: double sink vanity with black frame
landmarks.description: Long white double-sink countertop on an open black metal frame with white towels stacked on the lower shelf and a wide backlit mirror.

landmarks.name: frosted glass wooden door
landmarks.description: Wooden door with a large vertical frosted glass panel next to the double sink vanity and freestanding tub.

landmarks.name: glass-enclosed marble shower stall
landmarks.description: Walk-in shower stall with large white and grey veined marble wall tiles and a clear glass door.

walk_summary: Start at the round white ottoman facing the vanity desk with mirror and open closet with white robe, then turn left to the wooden dresser with two blue paintings.
Turn right and walk past the round white ottoman and fire extinguisher cabinet toward the large bed with wood-paneled headboard and wall-mounted TV on wood panel.
Turn right past the wall-mounted TV on wood panel and go through the open wooden door past the large city night painting to the dark wood dining table with beige chairs.

Return through the open wooden door into the area with the large bed with wood-paneled headboard, walking between the yellow upholstered bench and the tan swivel desk chair to the brown chaise lounge.
Circle around the brown chaise lounge and tan swivel desk chair, then walk back past the yellow upholstered bench and turn left to exit through the open wooden door.
Walk past the large city night painting and around the dark wood dining table with beige chairs to the wooden console table with three fish sculptures and four-panel blue abstract wall art.
Step toward the sheer white window curtains, then turn right and walk past the wooden console table with three fish sculptures to the white Counter with mini-fridge.

Turn left to look across the TV on dark wood media console and yellow tufted ottoman, then walk onto the white floor tiles toward the entry wooden door with closer and console table with round shell mirror.
Turn right at the console table with round shell mirror to enter the doorway to the white toilet by grey stone-tiled wall and floating white sink vanity with backlit mirror.

Exit the doorway onto the white tiles, turn left past the white Counter with mini-fridge and four-panel blue abstract wall art, and walk past the dark wood dining table with beige chairs toward the large city night painting.

Turn left at the open wooden door and enter the doorway to the freestanding white tub, double sink vanity with black frame, and frosted glass wooden door, stepping into the glass-enclosed marble shower stall on the left.
Step out of the glass-enclosed marble shower stall, walk past the double sink vanity with black frame and freestanding white tub to exit the doorway, then turn right at the open wooden door.

Walk past the dark wood dining table with beige chairs, four-panel blue abstract wall art, wooden console table with three fish sculptures, and white Counter with mini-fridge to the TV on dark wood media console and yellow tufted ottoman, then look toward the sheer white window curtains and back toward the entry wooden door with closer.
